text:
anya: about to start quiet-window deploy for routing-service v2.9. plan = tiny micro-canary + staged ramp for flag route_llm_canary. push timeline 00:00-00:45 UTC. steps: 0 -> 0.02 (micro-canary 4 hosts) -> 0.12 -> 0.4 -> 1.0. enterprise cohort pinned to model=v2.5 until final green. release notes: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-28/routing-v2.9

liam: ack. add deploybot holdpoint after 0.12. gates: error_rate > 1.6% OR p95 latency +25% OR quality_drop > 1% -> pause. also watch fallback-rate and cache-hit ratio. request session soft-drain 7m for canary. FYI support gets a blurb. :thumbsup:

deploybot: automated: created micro-canary group M (4 hosts). route_llm_canary -> 0.02. telemetry stream /ops/telemetry/deploy/7999999999 live. holdpoint scheduled at step 2.

anya: enabling smoke subset (smoke_fast) and regression eval (reg_mini_A). quality gates: rouge_delta <= 0.9% and exact_match_loss <= 1.0%. sampling traces at 5%.

liam: small twist — if we see a minor quality regression (0.8-1.2%) but latency improves >10% and token_cost decreases, consider a soft-rollforward: keep flag at 0.4 for 1h and monitor instead of immediate rollback. i.e., fallback to 0.5 partial not full 0 to help stabilize. we'll only do soft-rollforward with ops approval. added as an exception in runbook.

anya: noted. we'll only use soft-rollforward with explicit ack from liam + ops and a clear revert plan. enterprise pin unchanged.

support: prepping support blurb with pinned-model note and rollback steps; will stage in Zendesk snippets.

deploybot: micro-canary metrics @ +6m: error_rate=0.6% p95=210ms (+9%) token_cost=-1% fallback_rate=0.4% reg_mini_A delta=+0.3% -> within gates. proceeding to 0.12 in 8m.

liam: good. infra please warm +12% GPU headroom at +12m.

ops: autoscale scheduled +12% at +12m. hold contact list updated.

anya: copying quick rollback snippet into thread for ops clipboard:
```
# immediate revert to previous flag state and drain new hosts
curl -X PATCH -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood/flags/route_llm_canary -d '{"value":0}'
# drain micro-canary group M gracefully
deploybot action: drain --group microCanaryM --grace 420
# re-pin enterprise routing to model v2.5 (if needed)
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood/routing/pin -d '{"cohort":"enterprise","model":"v2.5"}'
```

deploybot: telemetry @ +15m: at 0.12 -> error_rate=0.9% p95=230ms (+14%) token_cost=-0.5% reg_mini_A delta=+0.6% cache-hit stable. holdpoint check: gates clear. continuing to 0.4 in 10m.

liam: reminder: if quality delta enters 0.8-1.2% band and latency improves >10%, call me + ops for soft-rollforward decision. otherwise full rollback on any gate trip.

anya: understood. scheduling final promote to 1.0 at 00:42 UTC unless holdpoint trips. will post release note to #release-notes after final green. updates every ~8m or immediately on gate trip. :eyes:
